text: No, do not retry it. A failed_after_tool_call error (HTTP 424) means a failure happened after an MCP tool or moss_search already ran, and an MCP tool may have changed data, so replaying the request could repeat that side effect. The 424 carries x-should-retry: false, so the Moss SDKs will not retry it either. Fix the cause or handle the failure at the application level instead of replaying the same request. Include the X-Moss-Request-Id when reporting it.
